title: agent-sandbox agent catalog
description: The shape of agents.nix. Validated at build time by the `agents-schema` check, against the catalog rendered to JSON with each agent's `package` reduced to its store path.

flagMapping.description: The arguments an agent spells a value-taking launcher flag with. The user's value replaces a `{}` token, or is appended when there is none. Omit the key entirely to say the agent does not support the flag -- the launcher then refuses the run. An empty list is rejected rather than read as 'unsupported', so a mapping that was meant to be filled in cannot pass for a deliberate omission.

allOf.description: At most one `{}` placeholder: the value is spliced in exactly once.

homePath.description: A path under the container's $HOME, relative and without traversal.

name.description: The subcommand that launches this agent, and the key the launcher's per-agent state mounts are named after.

package.description: Store path of the derivation providing the agent's binary.

command.description: argv the container runs for an interactive launch. A bare positional here is passed to the agent verbatim, so it must be one the agent actually accepts -- several agents read a positional as the first prompt, not as a project directory.

programmaticArgs.description: Arguments appended to `command` for a `--prompt -` run, making the agent read its prompt from stdin and exit. Omit the key to say the agent has no non-interactive mode; the launcher then refuses `--prompt` for it.

state.description: Directories under $HOME that persist the agent's login and history across launches.

stateFiles.description: Individual files under $HOME that persist, for agents that keep state outside a directory of their own.
